alt.en: Three-beat plate: unused supply, a meeting that never happened, unused demand
alt.zh: 三格图：闲置供给、从未发生的相遇、闲置需求

caption.en: Allocation Loss — value that was never created because the meeting never happened.
caption.zh: 配置损耗——因为相遇没有发生而从未被创造的价值。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: more factors, worse matching, seven signals converging on one gap
alt.zh: 三格图：要素更多、匹配更差、七个信号汇入同一个缺口

caption.en: Why now — seven structural signals point at the same allocation gap.
caption.zh: 为什么是现在——七个结构性信号指向同一个配置缺口。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: the sentence, four people meet, the 2036 field
alt.zh: 三格图：那句话、四个人相遇、2036 的网络

caption.en: 2036 — from one sentence to a network of verified connections.
caption.zh: 2036——从一句话到一张被验证的连接网络。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: desire, trust, learning as seven principles
alt.zh: 三格图：欲望、信任、学习构成的七条原则

caption.en: Principles — desire first, evidence over title, outcomes teach the network.
caption.zh: 原则——欲望优先，作品重于头衔，结果教会网络。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: idea, persistence, verified outcome
alt.zh: 三格图：想法、坚持、被验证的结果

caption.en: Proof of Contribution — evidence of work and persistence, not a score on a person.
caption.zh: 贡献证明——记录工作与坚持的证据，而不是给人打分。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: people intelligence, creativity allocation, production factor network
alt.zh: 三格图：人才情报、创造力配置、生产要素网络

caption.en: Category — people search is the door, allocation results are the destination.
caption.zh: 品类——人才搜索是入口，配置结果才是终点。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: the query, three evidenced hits, the introduction
alt.zh: 三格图：一次提问、三个带证据的结果、一次引荐

caption.en: Sleptons Radar — describe the person you wish existed, then meet them.
caption.zh: Sleptons Radar——描述你希望存在的那个人，然后与他相遇。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: capability and creativity, desire and trust, outcome
alt.zh: 三格图：能力与创造力、欲望与信任、结果

caption.en: Five graphs, one allocation network — the Outcome Graph is the part that compounds.
caption.zh: 五张图谱，一张配置网络——结果图谱是会复利的那一层。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: find and claim, desire and intro, outcome and learning
alt.zh: 三格图：发现与认领、欲望与引荐、结果与学习

caption.en: The product in six acts — match, interact, outcome, learning.
caption.zh: 产品的六幕——匹配、互动、结果、学习。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: the ICP trio, the creator, company and capital
alt.zh: 三格图：三类核心用户、创造者、公司与资本

caption.en: Who starts the network — seekers, builders and organizers make the first liquidity.
caption.zh: 谁先启动网络——寻找者、建造者与组织者构成最初的流动性。

alt.zh: 三格图：描述、相遇、各归其位

caption.en: Put potential in motion. Everything, where it belongs.
caption.zh: 让潜能流动起来。让一切各归其位。

alt.en: Three-beat plate: year one, year two, year three of the long route
alt.zh: 三格图：长路线的第一年、第二年、第三年

caption.en: The long route — from people and creativity to a production factor network.
caption.zh: 长路线——从人与创造力，走向生产要素网络。
